value: Coburn, J. (RTI International) (2021). Memorandum to Karen Marsh, U.S. EPA: Summary of Spreadsheets used for Tank Battery Impact Estimates. November 1, 2021. EPA Docket No. EPA-HQ-OAR-2021-0317-0039.

Two-page docket memo listing the spreadsheet files (EPA Control Cost Manual flare, thermal oxidizer and modified carbon-adsorber/VRU calculation sheets for model plants MP0-MP11, VRU sizing flows, StTanks_Control_Costs_v5.1, model tank battery emission distribution) used for the storage vessel/tank battery impacts in the November 2021 proposal TSD. Holds no numbers; the costs it points to are printed in the 2021 TSD Tables 6-9 to 6-15 (extracted as epa_2021_oil-gas-nsps-eg-proposal-tsd, epa_2021_001). The spreadsheets themselves are not held.
